title: Report initialization and outcome
responsibility: Creates an active report and derives an outcome from its recorded items.

inputs.name: reportState.input
inputs.description: Data used to start a report: a project path, title, mode, and optional environment, revision, historical flag, summary, and acceptance list. Project and title must be truthy and mode must be feature or suite; project is resolved, historical is coerced to boolean, and falsy environment, summary, and acceptance values fall back to local, empty string, and empty array while revision passes through.

inputs.name: resultStatus.report
inputs.description: Report record whose checks, findings, coverage, and evidence item statuses are combined; check count and whether every check is skipped also affect the result. The value is read as supplied.

inputs.name: interrupted.report
inputs.description: Report record whose state and updatedAt timestamp are checked against the current clock. It is considered interrupted only when state is not finalized and the elapsed time is greater than 15 minutes.

outputs.name: reportState
outputs.description: A sanitized Report created when reportState starts a report, with a generated UUID, a project id derived from the resolved path, and identical ISO start and update times. It starts running and active with empty checks, evidence, findings, and coverage; falsy environment, summary, and acceptance values use the code fallbacks local, empty string, and empty array, while historical is coerced to boolean.

outputs.name: resultStatus
outputs.description: The aggregate Status for checks, findings, coverage, and evidence, with any failed item taking precedence and blocked, not-proven, interrupted, or running items producing blocked. With no checks it returns not-proven; otherwise all skipped checks produce skipped and the remaining cases produce passed.

outputs.name: interrupted
outputs.description: A boolean indicating whether a report outside the finalized state has an updatedAt time more than 15 minutes before the current clock. A finalized report returns false, and an invalid timestamp also fails the age comparison.

errors.name: InvalidReportStateInputError
errors.description: Throws InvalidReportStateInputError("Project, title and valid mode are required") when project or title is falsy, or mode is neither feature nor suite.
